plain_english_summary: Reviewed PR #70. It is narrow and build/tests pass, but merge is blocked because malformed JSON label rows can be accepted by the upload route. No merge/deploy/DB writes happened.

blockers.summary: JSON row validation checks required fields with separate some(...) calls, so two bad rows can combine to pass validation.
blockers.evidence: One-off helper probe returned ok=true for rows with one object containing only sample_id and another containing only final_decision. Alternate-port POST to the PR route returned HTTP 200 ok=true and saved the malformed JSON to /tmp. Expected pre-merge behavior is HTTP 400 reject.
blockers.recommended_fix: Require each submitted JSON row to have its own sample_id and at least one primary decision field, or otherwise validate labels_by_sample_id entries explicitly. Add RED helper + route smoke coverage for split/missing fields, then rerun build and review.

warnings: PR is still a draft. Even after blocker fix, it needs to be marked ready before normal merge.
GitHub reports no CI checks, so local verification is the available gate.
suggestions: Add nonblocking hardening later: deeper object-shape/row-count limits beyond the 2 MB file cap.
Consider not using token-derived prefixes in public stored filenames in a later small follow-up, even though the token is one-time and used after upload.
